name: EPack Prefab Technologies Limited
summary: EPack Prefab Technologies Limited engages in manufacturing Pre-engineered and Prefabricated Building Solutions and EPS (Expanded Polystyrene) Packaging. Pre-engineered and Prefabricated Building Solutions engages in the designing, manufacturing, installation, and erection of pre-engineered steel buildings, pre-fabricated structures, and its components in India and internationally.
